The structure of CoMoS₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—Co₈Mo₈S₁₆—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Co centers with a tetrahedral environment of four S neighbors and Mo centers with six S neighbors, while each S center has four geometric neighbors, two Co and two Mo. The resulting neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts include corner-sharing between Co tetrahedra and corner-sharing between Co tetrahedra and Mo six-vertex coordination polyhedra.
